spec_features.spec_quote: Run up to 50 turns per trial before forced termination
spec_features.evidence: config.py:12 MAX_TURNS = 50; experiment_harness.py:240 `while turn_count < ExperimentConfig.MAX_TURNS:` bounds the tool loop, and lines 318-319 set stopped_reason when turn_count >= MAX_TURNS. The cap is actually read and breaks/ends the loop.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced hard cap on the number of turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: MAX_TURNS = 50  # Max turns before stopping a run

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop trial early if: 1. Model explicitly says "I give up" or equivalent
spec_features.evidence: experiment_harness.py:323-336 _should_stop checks self.state.turns[-1].model_response.lower() for phrases ['i give up','cannot solve','impossible','unsolvable','no solution'] and returns True; lines 309-311 break the loop when _should_stop returns True. The dispatch is real and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Fires on substring match of give-up phrases in the latest model response; this is a real enforced early termination.

spec_features.spec_quote: Test results haven't changed in 10+ turns (no progress)
spec_features.evidence: experiment_harness.py:339-343 gates the check on `len(self.state.test_results_history) > 0`, but test_results_history is never appended to anywhere (grep shows only its declaration at line 26 and the two reads at 339/341, no .append). So the condition is always False and this stop never fires.
spec_features.notes: Dead branch: the history list it inspects is permanently empty, so no-progress detection is not enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Stop if we've done many turns without progress
